description:
pkix-revocation/src/lib.rs:26

`pkix_revocation::Error` derives only `Debug`. It is missing `Clone` and potentially `PartialEq`.

Comparison:
- `pkix_path::Error` also derives only `Debug` (no Clone/PartialEq) — which is consistent but suboptimal.
- `pkix_path_builder::Error` derives `Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash` — the full set appropriate for an error type used in tests.

The `SerialNumber` field in `Error::Revoked` does implement `Clone` and `PartialEq`, so the derives would work.

However, `CrlReason` (in `reason_code: Option<CrlReason>`) must also implement `Clone` and `PartialEq` for the derives to work. If it does not, the derives would need to be added there or `reason_code` would need a wrapper.

Tests in pkits_crl.rs currently use pattern matching (`matches!(result, Err(Error::Revoked { .. }))`) rather than `==`, which works without `PartialEq`. But callers in production code who want to compare or store errors are impacted.

Fix: Add `#[derive(Clone, PartialEq)]` to `Error` (after verifying `CrlReason` and `SerialNumber` support it). This is consistent with the `pkix_path_builder::Error` precedent.
title: pkix-revocation: Error type missing Clone and PartialEq derives
